 Diesel, ATF export duties raised; domestic fuel prices unchanged
 By News Desk 
 Tuesday, 17 November 2026, 11:57:12 IST 
 0 
 Facebook WhatsApp X Telegram 
 The Central Government has increased windfall taxes on diesel and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) exports during its latest fortnightly review of domestic fuel export duties. 
 According to a Finance Ministry notification, the government raised the special additional excise duty and road cess on diesel exports to Rs 14 per litre from Rs 11.50. 
 Officials also hiked the export duty on aviation turbine fuel to Rs 12.50 per litre, up from the previous rate of Rs 11 per litre. 
 However, the government retained the export levy on petrol at zero for the second consecutive fortnight, offering continued relief to domestic fuel exporters. 
 The Finance Ministry confirmed that these newly revised export duty rates took immediate effect across the country starting November 16. 
 This latest hike follows the government’s October 31 review, when authorities completely withdrew the export duty on petrol while simultaneously raising levies on diesel and ATF. 
 During that October review, officials increased the diesel export duty to Rs 11.50 per litre from Rs 8.50, and raised ATF duty to Rs 11 from Rs 10.50. 
 The government conducts these fortnightly reviews to align fuel export duties with ongoing fluctuations in international crude oil and refined product prices. 
 Authorities have frequently revised fuel export taxes since reintroducing them in March, after geopolitical tensions in West Asia triggered severe volatility in global energy markets. 
 While officials initially imposed the windfall levy only on diesel and ATF exports, they later extended the tax to cover petrol exports starting in May. 
 Since then, policymakers have adjusted these rates multiple times to balance changing global market conditions with domestic fuel supply needs. 
 Furthermore, the Finance Ministry clarified that domestic retail taxes remain unchanged, ensuring no direct impact on petrol and diesel prices for local consumers.
